description:
Purpose:
  This regression inventory keeps tab-wise traceability between the Cucumber BDD suite,
  existing Playwright automation, standalone Chrome automation flows, and documented
  negative scenarios. It does not change application data.

elements.name: Positive regression coverage is traceable to an implemented automation source

steps.name: the Construction Delivery automation catalog is loaded
the "REG-01" "Delivery, recurring, multi-vehicle, and resource bookings" use case for "Booking Creation" should be documented with "automated-flow" coverage from "run-full-application.js"
the catalog command "npm run automate:full-application" should be available when provided
